verdict.rationale: Warp's homepage claims an "API, CLI, SDK and MCP built as a platform" and invites developers to "build on Warp" with factories as code. A published OpenAPI spec and API-triggered cloud agents back up a programmatic surface. Beyond that one line, though, the SDK itself is undocumented in the pack, so support is only glancingly evidenced. Missing for 10: SDK documentation (supported languages, package names, install and usage examples), API reference coverage for the SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against it.
